stemMd: A sequence alternates +4 and −1, starting with +4 from initial value 10. What is the value after nine operations?
explanationMd: Eight operations make four pairs, each adding three, taking the value to 22. The ninth operation is +4, giving 26. Separate complete cycles from the remaining step.

distractorRationale.b: Four full pairs give 22 and the last operation gives 26; 23 miscounts the final addition.
distractorRationale.e: This treats every operation as a net pair change.
distractorRationale.a: This assumes a constant increase of one per operation.
